messages:
alex_release: Heads-up: rolling SDK 3.9 at 22:00 UTC. It changes how model->runtime affinity is evaluated and can cause mismatches on multi-tenant Dedicated pools. Proposing tenant-scoped pin option rather than global to avoid impacting other customers.

morgan_sre: Tenant-scoped pins sound safer. We can do: `rbctl runtime pin --tenant TENANT_ID --runtime-version v2.16 --ttl 48h --reason "sdk3.9 compat hold"` -- deploybot should honor tenant field.

rita_eng: Confirmed deploybot supports tenant flag but note: for shared pools the pin will only affect routing decisions for that tenant's traffic; it won't block autoscaler.

chao_qa: Ran quick regression: sdk3.9 + runtime v2.15 shows a 3% rerank diff on few client prompts. With runtime v2.16, diffs drop to <0.5%. Recommend tenant pin for known affected customers.

ivy_prod: We have one large Dedicated customer (TENANT-42) on v2.15. We should contact account team but also prepare pin ops. I don't want an unexpected break for them.

alex_release: Agreed. Plan: 1) notify account manager for TENANT-42 2) schedule tenant-pin at 21:50 UTC (10m before rollout) 3) canary for the tenant for 30m 4) lift pin if metrics good.

morgan_sre: Proposed triggers for lift: error rate delta <= 0.5% over baseline for 20m AND p95 latency delta <= +150ms for 20m AND no 5xx > 0.2% window. If any breached, extend pin and open rollback ticket.

rita_eng: Ops commands for the runbook: ```
# tenant pin
rbctl runtime pin --tenant TENANT-42 --runtime-version v2.16 --ttl 48h --reason "sdk3.9 compat hold"
# check pinned routes
rbctl routes list --tenant TENANT-42 --filter pinned
# unpin
rbctl runtime unpin --tenant TENANT-42 --reason "canary passed"
```

deploybot: [deploybot] scheduled: tenant canary for TENANT-42 at 21:50 UTC (30m). Global canaries start at 22:00 UTC. Monitoring hooks enabled.

chao_qa: QA note: also saw a small memory regression (~80MB) on the tenant's largest endpoint with sdk3.9 + v2.16 under load. Not blocking but log to perf backlog.

ivy_prod: I'll trigger the account outreach and add a short advisory in release notes for dedicated customers.

alex_release: OK locking. Manual owner for tenant-pin: @morgan_sre. If triggers fire and manual pin needed globally, @alex_release will escalate. Closing thread unless issues.
